scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['index.html','manifest.json','sw.js','profile-data.js','qrcode.min.js','profile.jpg','profile.ico','favicon.ico','version.json'].forEach(f=>{if(fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f,'www/'+f)}); console.log('✅ Synced web assets to www/ directory!');"
scripts.sync-www: npm run build && npx cap sync
